summary: Plan Mode (Cursor) maps to Planning Mode (ODD epistemic modes) - no execution until explicit permission to move to Execution Mode
impact: Prevents epistemic mode violations. When in Plan Mode, agent is epistemically in Planning Mode and must not execute changes. Execution requires explicit permission to transition to Execution Mode.

summary: odd-teaser v1.1 implemented as dumb manual categorization form - completely missed the point of LLM-based artifact detection
impact: Manual categorization UX is hostile to users. If users must click buttons to categorize their own writing, they will abandon the system. odd-teaser should detect artifact scents (learnings, decisions, overrides) automatically like odd-scribe does with journaling.

evidence.ref: user_quote: If I had to click buttons and decide myself what I just wrote was wholesale categorized as learning, decision, or override, I'd delete the system
user_quote: USE FREAKING odd-scribe style intuitive journaling looking for smells and signals

summary: Attempt left OPEN after deployment proves ritual-dependent workflows will fail
impact: Manual completion steps are forgotten under real conditions. The META.json showing status: OPEN and completed_at: null after actual deployment is direct evidence that ODD's anti-ritual principle is correct. Workflows requiring manual ceremony will drift.

evidence.ref: META.json with status: OPEN, completed_at: null despite deployment being complete
